messages:
ashley (PM): Heads-up — I added a compact scope badge into the keys list in the latest mock. Need quick feedback on visibility, copy, and rotate/revoke affordances. Mock: https://img.redwood/keylist-badge-v2.png

marco (Design): The badge works for density. Two immediate calls: 1) define a color semantics table (read-only, limited-write, admin) so users learn it; 2) make the badge reveal full scopes on interaction (tooltip or small panel) rather than trying to cram everything into the badge.

tess (Frontend): I can implement a hover tooltip, but keyboard users need an accessible target. We'll make the badge focusable and open a popover on Enter/Space. Use aria-describedby for screen readers.

olivia (Accessibility): Good. For the popover use role="dialog" or role="tooltip" depending on content complexity. If it contains actionable items (rotate/revoke) use dialog. Add aria-expanded and ensure focus trap is minimal. Announce on open: "Key scopes for <name>".

jin (Eng/Runtime): Note: our keys list API currently omits exact ACLs for orgs with strict compliance. We can add a short `scope_summary` string like "read, embeddings" to the list response so the UI doesn't have to fetch the full detail for each row. Full scope expansion stays behind the detail endpoint.

ashley (PM): Scope summary + a dedicated "view details" click sounds right. We should avoid accidental copying of full ACLs in list view. The detail modal requires an explicit action.

marco (Design): Copy for the badge tooltip: "Scopes: read · embeddings · limited-write". For keys with admin/* or wildcard show a micro :warning: indicator and subtle inline hint "broad access". Consider making the warning clickable to surface remediation suggestions.

tess (Frontend): Inline rotate/revoke buttons in the list feel noisy. Suggest a kebab menu with primary quick action (Rotate) and secondary actions inside. For mobile, ensure tap targets don't overlap the badge.

jin (Eng/Runtime): Rotate flow backend note: rotate returns the secret only once. UI must show an ephemeral copy box with explicit "Copy" and an "I saved this" confirmation toggle. Also log rotates that touch admin scopes for audit.

olivia (Accessibility): Ephemeral secret display: move focus into the modal, announce "New secret generated; copy now" and ensure keyboard users can copy the value. The confirmation control must be standard HTML button with accessible name.

ashley (PM): Draft rotate modal copy: "A new secret was generated. This is the only time it will be visible. Copy it now and store it securely. If you lose it, rotate again." Thoughts?

marco (Design): Trim: "New secret generated — you will only see it once. Copy now or rotate again later." Add a "How to store secrets" link. If the rotated key has broad scopes show an extra confirmation step.

tess (Frontend): For broad-scope rotates we should require a checkbox: "I understand this will invalidate existing tokens and may break services." That mitigates accidental rotates. I'll wire the UX to disable the final submit until checked.

jin (Eng/Runtime): Backend fine with that. We'll add a rotate audit flag when scope_breadth is high or wildcard present. ops-bot will emit audit events.

ops-bot: Audit log event queued: action=rotate key=def456 scope_breadth=10 flagged=true ts=2026-03-23T15:20:00Z

olivia (Accessibility): Empty state copy for scoped keys view: "No scoped keys yet — create one to limit access by scope." Make CTA keyboard-focusable and include an aria-live region that updates after creation.

ashley (PM): Also want a tiny last-used and last-rotated line in the key detail. Keep precise timestamps out by default, show relative times like "3d ago" or "Never used" to reduce surface of PII. For keys idle >90 days show a soft suggestion: "Consider rotating".

marco (Design): Visual: small timeline icon + muted text. For unused keys >90 days add a subtle banner in the detail with a suggested Rotate button.

tess (Frontend): Sorting idea: default to "recently used" but allow a saved view that surfaces "broad-scope" keys first. Do we have a scope_breadth metric?

jin (Eng/Runtime): We can emit scope_breadth:int (cardinality + wildcard penalty) in the list to drive sorting and filters. Also add org-level redaction flag so some orgs won't see scope strings in logs or list. UI should display "Scope details hidden for your org" with a link to request access.

olivia (Accessibility): One more: ensure the create-key modal fields have explicit label associations and the helper text uses aria-describedby. Test rotate modal flows with NVDA and VoiceOver.

ashley (PM): Great. Action items: Marco -> update mocks with warning states and "broad access" copy; Tess -> prototype keyboard/popover & kebab menu; Jin -> add scope_summary, scope_breadth, and org redaction; Olivia -> accessibility checklist for rotate/display flows. I'll capture acceptance criteria in the ticket. Thanks! :thumbsup:
